body_markdown:
Xcode 26.2
Simulator: iPhone 17 (why iPhone 14 Plus I don’t know :D)


SDK-version - 1.0.17


I have been integrated OpenReplay SDK
My integration example:
In AppDelegate:
**func** application(_ application: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: \[UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: **Any** \]?) → Bool {


```text
Openreplay.shared.serverURL = "https://openreplay.host.ru" (MOCK, real url is in my project)


Openreplay.shared.start(projectKey: "KEY", options: .defaults) (MOCK, real url is in my project)


Openreplay.shared.setUserID(UUID().uuidString)
....


**return** **true**


}


```


in SceneDelegate:
**func** scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession, options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) {
if let windowScene = (scene **as** ? UIWindowScene) {
window = TouchTrackingWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
… etc
}


I can see my touches during all session but this pic is static.
